item.title: GE Aerospace investing $55M at Huntsville site
item.description: GE Aerospace announced on Monday that it will invest $1 billion in its U.S. manufacturing facilities this year, including $55 million at its site in Huntsville.

item.title: U.S. Navy to cut ribbon on 2.2M square foot defense industrial facility in Alabama
item.description: U.S. Sen. Tommy Tuberville announced on Monday morning that a ribbon-cutting will be held in the next few weeks for a 2.2 million square foot subcomponents facility in Muscle Shoals.
